title: The Charter Skipper — EN/IT/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 104bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Italian Portuguese language learning Pete Pelican
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
He used to nail down roofs in the Western Australian heat
Now he reads the swell before the harbour and the fleet
The same hands that drove the nails now turn the wheel
The charter skipper knows the difference in the feel

[Verse 2 — Italian, with English translation]
Una volta inchiodava i tetti nel caldo australiano
[He used to nail roofs in the Australian heat]
Ora legge le onde con tocco sopraffino
[Now he reads the waves with a refined touch]
Le stesse mani che picchiavano i chiodi guidano il timone
[The same hands that hammered nails guide the helm]
Il capitano charter conosce il mare con passione
[The charter skipper knows the sea with passion]

[Chorus — English]
The charter skipper on the morning run
Reads the weather and the water and the angle of the sun
The charter skipper used to be up on the tiles
Now he's out past Rottnest doing nautical miles
That's my boy

[Bridge — Portuguese, with English translation]
Ele pregava telhados sob o calor australiano
[He used to nail roofs under the Australian heat]
Agora lê as ondas com olhar veterano
[Now he reads the waves with a veteran's eye]
As mesmas mãos que pregavam agora viram o leme
[The same hands that nailed now turn the helm]
O capitão charter conhece o mar sem que treme
[The charter skipper knows the sea without trembling]

[Outro — All three languages]
Charter skipper knows… Il capitano charter sa… O capitão charter sabe
From roof to water — Dal tetto all'acqua — Do telhado à água
That's my boy
